headline: Cardinal Health (CAH) On A Strong Run With Fair Value Still In Focus
summary: Cardinal Health (CAH) is back in focus for investors after a recent move in its share price, with the stock last closing at $230.03. The shift has sharpened attention on its valuation and fundamentals. See our latest analysis for Cardinal Health. Recent moves in Cardinal Health's share price sit against a stronger backdrop, with a 90 day share price return of 17.82% and a 1 year total shareholder return of 48.99%, which suggests momentum has been building despite a softer 30 day share price...
